lessons.title: let, const and template strings.
lessons.explain: const is the default and let is for values that change. Strings join with + or template literals.
lessons.exercise: Make a variable for your name and log a greeting built with a template literal.

lessons.title: map, filter and reduce.
lessons.explain: map transforms every item, filter keeps some, and reduce folds a list into one value. None of them change the original array.
lessons.exercise: Use reduce to add up the numbers in an array.

lessons.title: Change a page from code.
lessons.explain: The DOM is the live tree of your page. Find an element, then react when the user acts on it.
lessons.exercise: Make a button that counts clicks and shows the number on itself.

lessons.title: Fetch data with async and await.
lessons.explain: fetch returns a promise and await pauses the function until it resolves, which keeps async code readable.
lessons.exercise: Load JSON from a URL, log one field, and wrap it in try/catch.

capstone: A to-do app with filters that remembers items between visits.
